name: OneUptime

evidence.uptime: C02: website, API, ping, DNS and SSL checks from hosted or private probes (U01)
evidence.errors: E01: exception span events and error logs grouped into issues
evidence.status: S01, S03: status pages with custom domains on all plans (S01, S03)
evidence.logs: L02: log search by time, service and severity, with saved views
evidence.performance: A01: OpenTelemetry traces with waterfalls, flame graphs and service maps
evidence.cron: J01: incoming-request monitors alert when no request arrives in time

line: Tracks exceptions, logs and uptime, with hosted and self-hosted status pages.
